response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and some high-throughput, low-latency backend work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers and caching — a reasonable analogue for systems-level thinking. However, the core requirement of modern C++ (or Rust) production experience is largely absent: his only C/C++ work was roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis, and the last decade has been overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js/D full-stack and product work. There is also no navigation guidance or routing-tile/pipeline experience, and limited evidence of distributed-systems fundamentals like consistency models or fault tolerance at global scale. He could be a fit if the team values geospatial domain knowledge and language-agnostic learning ability over immediate C++ productivity, but he would need significant ramp-up.
strengths: Deep, sustained geospatial/GIS experience across multiple projects
Proven low-latency, high-throughput service work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, Linux/DevOps breadth
concerns: Minimal and dated modern C++ experience; no Rust
No navigation/routing pipeline or map-tiling background
Recent decade focused on web/full-stack TypeScript rather than systems programming
